name: cluster_links
title: How two cluster servers establish their links
summary: An offline operator signs membership. Each server verifies it and maintains its own outbound YTP/1 session to every peer, with distinct directional PSKs.

nodes.title: Operator
nodes.note: Signs the cluster list and routes view. Its private key stays off the servers.

nodes.title: Node A
nodes.note: Checks both signatures, expiry and serial. Its outbound session uses B's TLS trust, admission key and the A-to-B PSK.

nodes.title: Node B
nodes.note: Authenticates A as a peer with its inbound PSK and grants only yume.circuit. Its own outbound session to A is separate.
